problem:
Let $Z=XY.$ What is the value of ${z}_{24}$, if

$$
X=[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 \\ 3 & 2\end{aligned}],\,Y=[\begin{aligned}2 & 0 & 5 & -3 \\ -4 & 1 & -1 & 2\end{aligned}]?
$$

${z}_{24}=$
{{field-1}}
worked_solution:
Multiplying the $2$nd row in $X$ by the $4$th column in $Y,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{z}_{24} & =[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 \\ 3 & 2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}2 & 0 & 5 & -3 \\ -4 & 1 & -1 & 2\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}3 & 2\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}-3 \\ 2\end{aligned}] \\  & =3(-3)+2(2) \\  & =-9+4 \\  & =-5.\end{aligned}
$$
